title: Document multi-machine beads sync; de-machine-ify memories
description: Two problems found while auditing. (1) Beads memories travel between machines via the git-tracked .beads/issues.jsonl (the embeddeddolt DB is gitignored), so any machine-local fact stored in a memory is read as truth on the other machine and is false there. Two of four memories are polluted this way. (2) Auto-import on pull depends on core.hooksPath pointing at .beads/hooks, which is --local git config and therefore NOT tracked by git. If it is unset on the second machine, git pull does not import, and that machine's next bd write exports issues.jsonl from a stale DB — committing that can delete the other machine's issues. Needs documenting in CLAUDE.md plus a CLAUDE.local.md convention for machine-local facts.
acceptance_criteria: CLAUDE.md documents the multi-machine sync contract and the core.hooksPath prerequisite; CLAUDE.local.md is gitignored and holds machine-local facts; the two polluted memories contain only clone-and-machine-independent facts.
close_reason: CLAUDE.md now documents the memory-scope rule and multi-machine sync contract (core.hooksPath prerequisite, post-pull import check, stale-export data-loss path, jsonl conflict procedure). CLAUDE.local.md gitignored and populated. Two polluted memories rewritten; memory-hygiene rule added as its own memory.

title: Fix make install / CONTRIBUTING for the beads hooksPath conflict
description:
'make install' runs 'uv run pre-commit install', which exits 1 with 'Cowardly refusing to install hooks with core.hooksPath set' whenever beads owns core.hooksPath. The target therefore aborts after uv sync, so setup never completes for a maintainer with bd installed. CONTRIBUTING.md step 4 gives the same broken command unconditionally.

Correct split: outside contributors without bd have no hooksPath set, so 'pre-commit install' is right for them. With bd, the commit gate is already tracked in .beads/hooks/pre-commit so there is no hook to install — only the hook environments need pre-building, which is 'pre-commit install-hooks' (verified exit 0 despite hooksPath). 'pre-commit run --all-files' is a lint pass, not a setup step; it only builds envs as a side effect.
acceptance_criteria: make install completes on a clone where core.hooksPath is set; CONTRIBUTING.md documents both the with-bd and without-bd paths and how to verify; CLAUDE.md's make install description matches.
close_reason: make install now branches on core.hooksPath: pre-commit install-hooks always, plus pre-commit install only when hooksPath is unset. Both branches verified (exit 0 in beads mode; hook installs to .git/hooks/pre-commit with hooksPath genuinely unset, then restored). CONTRIBUTING.md and CLAUDE.md updated.

title: Gate ruff via .beads/hooks/pre-commit; clear broken pre-commit env cache
description:
Root cause of the recurring lint/hygiene drift (see vndb-client-a21): the beads integration sets core.hooksPath to .beads/hooks, and the Python pre-commit framework refuses to install while that is set ('Cowardly refusing to install hooks with core.hooksPath set'). So make install has never actually gated ruff, and bd does not chain to .git/hooks or to pre-commit.

Verified fix path (tested 2026-07-25 on a throwaway branch): content placed in .beads/hooks/pre-commit BELOW the END BEADS INTEGRATION marker runs after bd's own block, a non-zero exit from it blocks the commit, and 'bd hooks install --beads' preserves it across reinstall. .beads/hooks/ is git-tracked, so the gate propagates to every clone automatically.

BLOCKED first by a filesystem fault: C:/Users/ml-na/.cache/pre-commit/repog4dqji1n/py_env-python3 denies access even to Get-Acl unelevated, and pre-commit dies trying to rmtree it during env setup. Needs an elevated shell to remove. Do not add the hook line before this is fixed — every commit would fail.
acceptance_criteria: pre-commit env builds ('uv run pre-commit run --all-files' completes); .beads/hooks/pre-commit invokes it below the END marker; a deliberate ruff violation is blocked at commit time; the change is committed so the other workstation inherits it.
close_reason: pre-commit env cache cleared (human, elevated); 'uv run pre-commit run --all-files' now passes all ten hooks on the whole tree, which covers a21's trailing-whitespace and final-newline conditions with real hook evidence. Ruff gate added below the END BEADS INTEGRATION marker in .beads/hooks/pre-commit and verified to block a deliberate F821 violation (commit b8fcffd), so the drift cannot silently recur.

value: Superpowers' verification and delegation scaffolding predates Opus 5 and now causes over-verification and needless subagent spawning. This repo's CLAUDE.md has a 'Superpowers overrides (Opus 5)' section which is the authority — read it there rather than restating it. Two rules for maintaining it: never pin the overrides to a superpowers version number (plugins auto-update, and a version stamp reads as an expiry date — key them to what the skills SAY), and never edit the plugin cache to apply them (it is version-pinned and overwritten on update).

PEP 639 license gotcha (hatchling >=1.27 emits Metadata-Version 2.4): in pyproject [project], using the SPDX 'license = "MIT"' expression AND a 'License :: OSI Approved :: ...' trove classifier together is forbidden and modern twine/PyPI reject the upload. Use the SPDX license field + license-files only; do NOT also add a License:: classifier. twine check may still pass locally but the upload fails. Verify by building the wheel and inspecting METADATA for both License-Expression and Classifier: License lines.

Traps this repo's own files do NOT record. (The hooksPath/pre-commit conflict IS documented — CONTRIBUTING.md 'Troubleshooting setup', the Makefile HOOKSPATH comment, and the comment block in .beads/hooks/pre-commit. Read those, don't restate them.) (1) The ruff gate in .beads/hooks/pre-commit is guarded by 'command -v uv', so it degrades SILENTLY where uv is off PATH — prove it works by confirming a bad commit is BLOCKED, never by checking the file exists. (2) Never 'fix' make install back to a bare 'pre-commit install': it exits 1 while beads owns core.hooksPath, aborting the target. (3) The Dolt DB and issues.jsonl live in the MAIN checkout's .beads/, not worktrees — bd runs from a worktree but exports to the main path, so a worktree's committed issues.jsonl can be stale; worktrees also get only 'uv sync', never 'make install'. (4) The issues.jsonl export LAGS the bd write — a close/update may not reach the file until a later bd command flushes it, so re-check git status before assuming it's committed.

Memories are NOT machine-local: .beads/embeddeddolt is gitignored but .beads/issues.jsonl is tracked and 'bd import' round-trips memories as well as issues, so each one reads as truth on every machine. Two scope rules: (1) hold only facts true in any clone on any machine — home-dir paths, sandbox quirks, locally-installed tools and harness permissions go in gitignored CLAUDE.local.md instead; (2) hold only what the repo does not record about itself — once a fact lands in a tracked file the memory copy is duplication paid every session, so point at the file.
